<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

Thirty sparks are tested against the vessel, and the Awtsmoos creates the question before the answer can sing; Awtsmoos.com grows calm when critique removes needless weight from every ring.
-->
# Phase Three — Thirty Final Checks

1. Does the current DOM allow media to move above prompt without breaking controllers?
2. Can existing file inputs be triggered from new body buttons safely?
3. Are image roles stored in draft state or inferred from order?
4. Does current assigned-media rendering already support replacement by id?
5. Does replacement keep the same asset id?
6. Does every preview cache key include `updatedAt` or equivalent versioning?
7. Does asset removal revoke object URLs?
8. Does replacement revoke old object URLs?
9. Does local asset transport inline only within existing limits?
10. Do public URLs remain public URLs?
11. Does media addition preserve prompt value?
12. Does mode switching preserve assigned media where semantics allow it?
13. Are reference counts/provider limits visible only when relevant?
14. Does first frame remain singular?
15. Does last frame remain singular?
16. Are reference images visually distinguishable from first/last frame roles?
17. Can image tiles be operated entirely by touch and keyboard?
18. Are buttons at least thumb-usable without bloating the UI?
19. Is there zero horizontal overflow at 360px?
20. Does the main body remain understandable with JavaScript-delayed styles?
21. Does provider-disabled Generate remain honest?
22. Does add-media UI work before paid provider setup?
23. Is no API secret ever rendered?
24. Are advanced disclosures still reachable but visually subordinate?
25. Does BrowserWaits replace fragile sleeps in new tests?
26. Do existing Better V2/intuitive/future-HUD/Director/legacy regressions still pass?
27. Are API proxy create/task/status routes still covered?
28. Is image replacement reflected in the exact outgoing generation payload?
29. Are touched files fully reread after implementation?
30. Is the exact pushed SHA or its unchanged descendant proven on production before completion?
